target_customer: Quick service restaurant chains and franchisees with drive-thru lanes
problem: Drive-thru order taking is a labor heavy job under rising wages and staffing shortages; Lilac Voice takes orders by voice AI and sends them to the kitchen.
business_model: B2B SaaS priced per location, with free pilots offered
product_category: Voice AI for restaurant drive-thru ordering

founders.name: Shelden Shi
prior_employers: Flatiron Health (per a profile, not the YC page)
founders.background_notes: A Standout profile says he later moved to Gini.

competitors.name: SoundHound
competitors.what: Voice AI vendor deploying drive-thru ordering
competitors.traction_then: Announced on 2023-08-02 an expansion with White Castle to over 100 drive-thru lanes by end of 2024; claimed 90% completion rate (company claim)

technical_complexity.rationale: Real time speech recognition in noisy drive-thru lanes, order accuracy including allergy modifications, and POS integration; a team of 4 could use existing speech and LLM models.

defensibility.rationale: POS integrations and deployments create some stickiness, but several funded rivals and the underlying models are available to all.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established vendors already had chain deployments in 2023 and 2024. No source reports whether Lilac was acquired or copied.

market_need_then: Chains piloted drive-thru voice AI in 2023 and 2024 (White Castle with SoundHound, Wendy's FreshAI) citing labor costs and speed; the YC description cites staffing shortages and rising wages.

branding.domain_note: Marketed on drive-thru.ai (a descriptive domain) and lilaclabs.ai per one directory; another voice AI platform also uses the name Lilac.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct pitch about automating the order taker, free pilots

branding.brand_signature: Free pilots for drive-thru voice AI

brand_strength.rationale: Little press on the brand; the product domain is descriptive and another Lilac voice platform exists.

outcome_analysis: Lilac Labs joined YC in Summer 2024 to sell drive-thru voice AI into a field where SoundHound, Presto and others already had chain deployments. A vendor case study in November 2024 shows it was shipping and testing at scale. YC now lists it inactive but some pages list it active, and no source explains a shutdown, so the cause is not public.
notes: The $4.2M seed rests on a single aggregator (Standout) and has no date; VCBacked and Caplight list only about $500K (pre seed or accelerator), and another profile says about $4.7M total. No primary announcement found. Location conflict: YC says San Francisco, one listing says Richardson, Texas. Some directories still say Active. drive-thru.ai returned HTTP 503 during the check, so no dead site claim. Hamming case study (2024-11-08) is vendor published. Exit unknown.
